readme: Members of family 11 and family 7 at periapsis, for the frames demo and the corrector demo. Each state is (x, y, z, xdot, ydot, zdot) in the rotating-pulsating frame, nondimensional, at the epoch theta = theta0 = 0, with the velocity as the derivative with respect to the true anomaly theta. Each period is in true anomaly and equals 2 pi, i.e. one revolution of the primary and the secondary. The units are those of the CSV files of the TyCHO Broucke example. Fields are described in README.md.
